title: Mo Xiansheng's Warning
next_chapter_hook: The moment Mo Xiansheng mentioned Su Qingyao's true name, a violent tremor came from beyond the Tianji Record — someone was forcibly breaking the formation.

text.content: Chen Ji's finger hovered just three inches from the spot of light, when that familiar girl's voice pierced his consciousness like an ice awl. "Brother, don't..." Chen Nian's voice carried unprecedented urgency, as if she were experiencing some indescribable pain. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, his extended hand frozen mid-air, fingertips trembling slightly. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm, his gaze shuttling between the spot of light and that void. Intuition told him this spot of light was no ordinary object — the aura it emanated was entirely different from the ancient grandeur of the Tianji Record itself, carrying instead a seductive sweetness... characteristic of a trap.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) Xiao Nian... what are you afraid of? Is it the spot of light itself, or... the one who set it?

text.content: At this moment, an异样涟漪 rippled through the depths of the Tianji Record. The golden space, originally as still as dead water, suddenly rippled with layers of waves. A phantom figure slowly emerged from the deepest pages of the book. The visitor wore gray-white robes, with white hair and beard, features so ancient and simple they seemed to have stepped out of ancient frescoes. His form flickered between bright and dim, as if it might dissipate into nothingness at any moment. Chen Ji's pupils constricted — this figure was all too familiar, precisely the Mo Xiansheng who called himself a守护残魂. However, the Mo Xiansheng of this moment emanated an entirely different aura from his usual self — within that ancient, weathered presence lurked a faint... murderous intent.

dialogue.content: (Voice aged yet somewhat at peace) You've finally arrived, child. Had your sister not warned you with her last strand of Heavenly Fate, you would have stepped into an abyss of eternal suffering.
(Eyes suddenly sharpening) Mo Xiansheng? No... your aura has changed. Before, you were merely a remnant soul, so why now can I feel tangible pressure from you? Who exactly are you?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng heard this, and a bitter smile appeared on his ancient face. He slowly raised his hand, phantom sleeves swaying without wind in the void, and faintly visible upon them were certain long-lost ancient patterns — markers unique to Celestial Arbiters. Chen Ji's heart sank violently, countless fragments in his mind suddenly connecting: Mo Xiansheng's uncanny familiarity with the Tianji Record, his perfectly timed guidance at critical moments, his deliberate avoidance of explaining the past... everything made sense. Mo Xiansheng was not an ordinary 守护残魂, but rather —

dialogue.content: (Sighing deeply) Correct. I was once one of the Seven Law Enforcement Arbiters of the Heavenly Tribunal. A thousand years ago, for opposing the Celestial Realm's plan to enslave the mortal world, I was stripped of divine status and, after having my memories sealed, thrown into the cycle of reincarnation. It was your father Chen Xuan's past-life memories that awakened me, allowing me to regain partial power in this remnant soul.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed shocking truth, and Chen Ji needed to react quickly. How should he deal with this deeply hidden 'Celestial Defector'?

choices.description: Directly demand why Mo Xiansheng concealed his identity and his true purpose in secretly helping him.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Mo Xiansheng and lose a key ally
choices.visible_reward: Gain more truth about the Celestial Realm's conspiracy
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's answer may overturn everything you thought you knew about him

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled, stepping back half a pace to create distance. His gaze was sharp as a blade, piercing directly into Mo Xiansheng's phantom eyes. (Voice deep) A thousand-year Law Enforcement Arbiter, Celestial defector... these identities are rather startling. Pray tell, sir, what have you been 'secretly helping' me toward all this time?

choices.text: Ask Him to Explain the Current Situation
choices.description: Temporarily suppress doubts and ask Mo Xiansheng to first explain the danger behind this spot of light and the true purpose of the Celestial Realm.
choices.visible_cost: May appear weak and be despised by Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to inform decision-making
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be more cruel than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hovering finger, slowly turning to face Mo Xiansheng. His expression was calm as an ancient well, unfathomably deep. (Calmly) Since your identity is now clear, I'd like to hear — what exactly is this spot of light? What grand game is the Celestial Realm playing?

choices.description: Using Chen Nian's safety as a point of entry, demand to know if Mo Xiansheng has long known about his sister's true situation.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the softest part of his heart
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key clues about Chen Nian's whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may use this as leverage

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze dimmed for a fleeting moment, then regained clarity. He did not question Mo Xiansheng's identity, but spoke softly. (Voice slightly trembling) Xiao Nian... how is she now? She said 'don't' — does she mean don't touch this spot of light, or don't continue investigating her whereabouts?

dialogue.content: (Expression grave) That spot of light is a lure set by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets — it appears to be a shortcut to a higher plane, but in truth is a trap to reclaim the Tianji Record. Once you touch it, the Tianji Record will automatically detach from your consciousness and be reclaimed by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. And your sister... the Heavenly Fate sealed within her is precisely the key to activate this trap.

text.content: Chen Ji's knuckles whitened from tension, a chill shooting from his spine to the crown of his head. He should have known — Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect, the Heavenly Fate lock key... these seemingly independent events hid such elaborate scheming behind them. Mo Xiansheng continued, his voice carrying suppressed fury. (Coldly) The Celestial Realm ostensibly wants to destroy the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, but in truth merely wishes to replace it. Once they succeed, all beings across the three realms will become puppets, even more tragic than under the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' control — because at least the Eye of Heavenly Secrets pursues balance, while the Celestial Realm's rulers... pursue absolute control.

dialogue.content: (A glimmer of determination in his eyes) But I've left something behind. A thousand years in the Law Enforcement Arbiters taught me a secret the Celestial Realm has tried desperately to erase — a Fourth Option. It requires no sacrifice from you, no sacrifice from your sister, and need not throw the three realms into chaos. It's just that this path... requires you to make a difficult choice.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng proposed a mysterious Fourth Option, claiming no sacrifice was needed from anyone. Faced with this proposal that could be either an opportunity or a trap, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Learn the Fourth Option in Detail
choices.description: Demand Mo Xiansheng fully explain the specifics and conditions of the Fourth Option, evaluating its feasibility.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes time, may miss other opportunities
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to reverse the situation
choices.risk_hint: The plan may have unknown costs or side effects

dialogue.content: (Sharp gaze) Speak. Every plan has its price; I need the complete truth.

choices.description: Refuse to passively accept Mo Xiansheng's arrangements, insisting on continuing according to his own pre-established chess game.
choices.visible_cost: May break with Mo Xiansheng and lose a vital source of intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain initiative in action,不被任何人左右
choices.risk_hint: The original plan may have already been anticipated by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.process_label: stay independent, control the big picture

dialogue.content: (Slight upturn at the corner of his mouth) Thank you for your kindness, sir, but Chen Ji's chess game was laid long ago. For a thousand years I've walked the world as a 'waste' — not to hand my fate over to others at the final moment.

choices.description: Indicate willingness to consider the Fourth Option, but demand Mo Xiansheng first provide equivalent筹码 as a show of good faith.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Mo Xiansheng and lead to negotiation breakdown
choices.visible_reward: Obtain additional guarantees and掌握谈判主动
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may refuse or make higher demands

dialogue.content: (Deep gaze) The plan is negotiable, but you need to give me a reason first — why choose me? A thousand years of reincarnation, you could have waited for a more suitable piece, so why bet everything on a 'waste'?

(Staring at Chen Ji for a moment, suddenly laughed) Good, good, good. The first mortal in a thousand years to dare negotiate with me — you are indeed Chen Xuan's son. Very well... The key to the Fourth Option lies in the crack between the 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets' and the 'Celestial Realm.' The Eye of Heavenly Secrets pursues balance, the Celestial Realm pursues control — this is a fundamental opposition. What you need to do is simultaneously ignite conflicts between both sides, letting them exhaust each other, while you... reap the benefits.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and a scroll woven from golden light materialized in the void. On the scroll, countless points of light scattered like stars, connected by lines, each line representing some causal or利益 relationship. Chen Ji gazed intently, his pupils suddenly tightening — the forces marked on that scroll were far vaster and more complex than anything he knew. The three great sects were merely visible pieces on the board, but in the shadows... there was the Holy Sect, the Celestial Envoys, the Ancient Survivors, and the 'Opposite Shore Forces' he had never touched. (Voice deep) This map... is this the intelligence network you've woven over a thousand years?

dialogue.content: (Nodding) Indeed. But I must warn you — among all the nodes on this web, one is most dangerous and most vulnerable — Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect. She is not as simple as she appears... The blood of the Celestial Law Enforcement lineage flows within her, only her memories have been sealed. The closer you walk with her, the easier it is for the Celestial Realm to notice you; and if she awakens... the first one she'll want to kill is you.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed Su Qingyao's shocking secret, and Chen Ji had to make a choice: continue this relationship or sever all ties?

choices.description: Firmly believe Su Qingyao will not betray him, and even with Celestial blood, hand his fate over to her.
choices.visible_cost: May face Celestial pursuit and fall into desperate straits
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden 'Shared Destiny' storyline, deepen bond with Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: The timing and manner of Su Qingyao's awakening are unknown
choices.process_label: sincerity for sincerity, face danger together

dialogue.content: (Silent for a long while, suddenly laughed) I understand what you say, sir. But in Chen Ji's life, I never abandon someone worth keeping because of risk. What Su Qingyao becomes is her decision; how I treat her is mine.

choices.text: Decide to Distance from Su Qingyao
choices.description: For the greater good,忍痛割爱, proactively keep distance from Su Qingyao to avoid dragging her into danger.
choices.visible_cost: May hurt Su Qingyao and bear emotional debt
choices.visible_reward: Reduce risk of being noticed by Celestial Realm, freer to act
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may develop misunderstandings due to being pushed away

dialogue.content: (Closing both eyes, slowly clenching fists) ...I understand. If my existence brings her disaster, then I'll stay away from her. She deserves a better life, not to sink alongside a piece like me.

choices.text: Demand Mo Xiansheng Assist in Control
choices.description: Since Su Qingyao carries Celestial blood, why not find a way to utilize this trait and turn it into an advantage for our side?
choices.visible_cost: May be discovered by Su Qingyao, relationship broken
choices.visible_reward: Obtain special counter against the Celestial Realm
choices.risk_hint: Exploiting emotions may lead to irreversible consequences
choices.process_label: turn weakness to advantage, calculate thoroughly

dialogue.content: (Cold glint in eyes) Since she carries Celestial blood, that makes it a double-edged sword. Do you have a method, sir, to let me gain the initiative before she awakens?

(Gazing meaningfully at Chen Ji) Your choice... I've noted it. Whatever decision you make, I will assist from the shadows. After all, if you fail, this old bag of bones will also escape dissolution. (Suddenly expression stern) But I must warn you — emotion is a cultivator's greatest weakness. Your obsession with Xiao Nian, your attachment to Su Qingyao, will all become vulnerabilities enemies exploit to attack you. Especially now... the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has already noticed you.

text.content: Before the words even finished, a earth-shaking roar suddenly came from beyond the Tianji Record. The originally dormant spot of light erupted with dazzling white light, and countless chains of符文 shot out from within, sweeping toward Chen Ji. Mo Xiansheng's face changed dramatically, the remnant soul trembling violently. (Sharp voice) Not good! The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has activated the reclamation program early! Child, quick... retreat into the depths of the Tianji Record. As long as it cannot lock onto your aura —

dialogue.content: (Suddenly turning back, gaze firmly locked on那片白光) No... Xiao Nian is still outside. Those chains' direction — they're heading toward the Holy Sect — they want to capture Xiao Nian to complete the reclamation!

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer, True Qi surging madly through his body. He seized that spot of light, allowing scalding agony to spread from his palm through his entire body — he was forcibly severing the connection between this trap spot of light and the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng cried out but couldn't stop him in time. (Roaring) I don't care about any reclamation program! Anyone who dares touch my sister, and I will make this world... bury her!

The moment Chen Ji僵持 with the spot of light, a clear yet familiar voice rang again in his mind — "Brother, don't be rash... I wasn't taken by them... I chose to stay..." Chen Nian's words came in fragments, as if she were enduring tremendous pain. (Pupils contracting violently) Xiao Nian? What... what are you saying? What do you mean by 'chose to stay'?

However, what answered him was only a burst of刺耳杂音, and then that connection completely severed. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had faded to near transparency. He used his last ounce of strength to speak. (Voice hoarse) Child... remember, the true chess game... is not within the three realms... but in... (His form completely dissolved, leaving only an ancient Jade Slip slowly falling) ...the Celestial Realm...

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, both hands tightly clutching that Jade Slip. His knuckles whitened from tension, veins bulging. After a long while, he slowly raised his head, the grief in his eyes gradually replaced by cold determination. (Murmuring softly) Xiao Nian... you said you chose to stay... why? What is in that place, worth protecting even if it means subjecting yourself to captivity? Mo Xiansheng... the Celestial Realm... and this so-called 'chess game'... everyone treats me as a piece, yet none of you... ever asked if I was willing. (He stood up, gaze like a blade) Fine. If that's how it is, then I'll overturn this chessboard and see what exactly lies at the end of this heaven.
